high_level_description: This image captures a stunning view of the night sky, dominated by the Milky Way galaxy. The central part of the image is brightly illuminated, showcasing the dense cluster of stars that make up the galaxy's core. Surrounding this bright area, there is a gradient of light, transitioning from a lighter blue near the center to darker shades towards the edges, indicating the vastness and depth of space. The image appears to be taken from a low angle, looking upwards towards the sky, which enhances the grandeur of the celestial scene.
